quest.title: As the Courtyard in Spring Once Appeared
quest.description: As you explore further, the mirage becomes ever more peculiar. Perhaps the decrepit view is a reflection of what Kazuha has been through. You wonder how those hardships he experienced will shape the view in his heart.
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x30, Mora x20000, Hero's Wit x2, Unyielding Rocks: Left x1, Unyielding Rocks: Right x1

chapter.title: As the Courtyard in Spring Once Appeared

talks.objective: Look around for the items you need

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: ...Seems like similar things happen every time I'm with you. I'll attempt divination, read the signs, zero in on the target, then solve the problem.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: You're surrounded by all kinds of friends, secrets, and destinies. It's incredible.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: No, you're incredible! You helped Fischl and us solve that Leonard situation.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is this a good thing for an astrologist?

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: All things considered, I suppose. Let's hope we can all stick together and resolve this, like we did last time.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: When you say together, do you mean the two of you, or all three of us?

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Pff...

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Okay, okay, the three of us then! Sometimes, Paimon offers an insightful perspective that can be very helpful to me.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Really? Paimon's starting to like you a lot, Genius Astrologist Mona!

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Yes, that's the perspective I'm talking about! You'll never meet another astrologist as clever and charming as me, ohohohoho!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah, everything about you's great, except for, um... please don't laugh like Fischl again... ever.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Ahem! Sorry... Heh, friends' habits rub off on you when you spend a lot of time together, don't they... haha... hah...

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: #I'll keep observing the stars. Keep in touch, {NICKNAME}.

talks.objective: Place the rock into the bonsai

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: ...When we set foot in this picture-perfect place, I never would've imagined we'd be dealing with such a mystifying occurrence.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How do you feel about it?

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Fine, I suppose. I could use some help though.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What do you need us to do?

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Um...

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Uhh... nothing, actually.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What? Are you underestimating us!?

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: No, I just realized that although you never talk much, you do so much for us all, quietly, in the background.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: You're the companion everyone needs. I think we're all very relieved to have you here.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: I know putting high expectations on you might give you some unwelcome pressure, but... I like to think an astrologist's observations can yield insights outside the night sky alone, and noticing other people's strengths is a kind of observation, too.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So you just wanted to compliment us?

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: I was simply stating the facts, not complimenting anyone.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hmm, so you can't admit...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...that you're actually complimenting someone!

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Stop smirking at me! I told you, it was an objective evaluation, not a compliment! Not a compliment!

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: #I'll keep observing the stars. Stay in touch, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What's happened here? Everything is broken...

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: ...Alas, the loftier the clan, the more devastating the fall.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Broken into pieces, and not a single soul around... This must be the way things ended.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: C'mon, let's get movin'.

talks.objective: Continue onward through the shattered space

dialogues.speaker: Boatman
dialogues.text: Kaedehara, that's you, right? Get on board, I'll get you out!

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: But... why are you helping me? I'm a wanted fugitive.

dialogues.speaker: Boatman
dialogues.text: Obviously the Yashiro— Ahem! An anonymous financial sponsor wants you to get out safely.

dialogues.speaker: Boatman
dialogues.text: But there's only so much they can do. After this, you'll be on your own.

talks.objective: Continue onward through the shattered space

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: There was supposed to be a dead plant in that flowerpot. However, there was nothing there.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: ...While we were separated, I had a lot of time to reflect. I think I finally understand now.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: The mirage is... me. The empty flowerpot represents the state of my heart.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: When the heart is clear, the world is too. And when the heart is unladen, the same is true.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Clear and unladen... that describes how I feel right now.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Although, I would not say there are no regrets in this. To be unladen is also to be empty.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: That's why this bonsai appeared as part of my mirage. It gave me a chance to fulfill my wishes.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: I never realized that deep down in my heart, I also wanted to make my own bonsai... Perhaps this is what it really means to keep Kaedehara traditions alive.

talks.objective: Continue onward through the shattered space

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Have you finished doing what you wanted to do, Kazuha?

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Yes, you could say that.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: You saw my past self and said goodbye to him. Only when you witness my whole story does it become truly consigned to history.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: What really matters in life is not how strict we are with ourselves, but the connections we make along the way. There's no future for those who linger on the past.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: So please believe me when I say that I've already come a long way, and I intend to go further still. I will always treasure your support.

Listen to the voice at the docks

dialogues.speaker: Sea Drake
dialogues.text: Hey, buddy! You okay? Need a ride or something?

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Heh, pirates?

dialogues.speaker: Sea Drake
dialogues.text: Hah, you could call us that! So, you coming or not?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: *yawn*... It's been a long trip today, Paimon's getting kinda sleepy...

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Everyone must be exhausted. Let's call it a day.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Hmm? What's wrong? You don't look too good.

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: Nothing. Perhaps today's arduous journey is making me feel slightly out of sorts.

dialogues.speaker: Oz
dialogues.text: Mein Fräulein, are you alright?

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: Oz, curb thy curiosity.

dialogues.speaker: Oz
dialogues.text: Yes, mein Fräulein.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: I'll see if I can find something for us to eat. Go ahead and rest if you're feeling tired, but anyone who's up to it is welcome to help out.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: I'll help.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Me too.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Everyone's volunteering to help! Maybe we should too!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Count us in.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Whoa, hey, I appreciate the enthusiasm, but...

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Her Highness looks kinda gloomy. Mona, you two seem close, why don't you keep her company for a while?

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: You noticed it too. I was going to bring it up with you while we were preparing the food. In that case, yes, just leave it to me.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Alright! We'll prepare the food!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Mona gives you a wink, then runs to stay with Fischl. Everyone else collects cooking ingredients...

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Yup, this should be enough. We can grill these. Next time we pass by one of those abandoned campsites, I'll see if they have a cooking pot. We'd have some more variety then.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, that's such a nice idea! You might not be a chef, Xinyan, but you sure do know how to keep the diners happy.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Aw shucks, Paimon. It's no big deal, just doing what I can!

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Even the crew mates of The Alcor consider Xinyan someone they can rely on.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We feel the same way about you, too, Kazuha!

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Hahaha, we sure do.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Hmm... Well then, as a trusted friend, I have something I'd like to talk about.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: From what you've been saying, that miraculous mirage seems to have been based on my life story to date.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: ...It felt just like a dream to me.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Maybe that's it. Maybe it represented your dreams.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: In other words... you've always wanted to make your own bonsai, right?

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Could that be it...? All that was a means of granting me something I wished for?

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: And since this happened to me, does that mean it could happen to everyone else, too?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yes, I think so.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: I agree. But I wonder whose mirage we'll encounter next?

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Hah, I'm actually kinda looking forward to my own mirage, if it's a dream come true like you say.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, you actually want something like this to happen with you, too?

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Aw heck, any mirage to do with me would probably be music-related. Hahaha, it'd be a good chance to showcase a few tunes!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You mean you'd wanna do a performance in there!?

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Why not? I don't think any self-respecting musician could stay silent on these islands. Just look at this place!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So much confidence and optimism! Xinyan rocks...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Oh, uh, {NICKNAME}! Paimon wants to try some of the fruit growing on that cliff over there. Let's go pick some!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Oh? Is this about...)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Carry on without us, I need a moment with Paimon.

talks.objective: Contact Venti in a less conspicuous place

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Kazuha! We found you!

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Good timing. I was just reflecting on my life so far, and I think I'm all up to date.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: So, what do you think of the Kaedehara Clan's bonsai?

choices.text: Looks like it carries lots of history.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Old things often carry around some form of regret. The Kaedehara Clan is no exception.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: But that's okay. Partings produce reunions, if not at home then in a distant land.

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: This mirage is quite fascinating. It presents life like a stage play, with each scene more captivating than the last.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: They say that astrologists have seen it all. So if this mirage intrigued you, that says it was a worthwhile encounter.

response.speaker: Fischl
response.text: Ahem... How fares thy mood?

response.speaker: Oz
response.text: Mein Fräulein inquires as to your present wellbeing, Lord Kazuha, hoping your heart is not too filled with sorrow.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: There's no way anyone could be cheerful after reliving all that...

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Haha, you have a point. Thank you all for your concern. Fortunately, all those things are past and gone now.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: When I first saw this bonsai, I thought of the possibility that... I needed to wait for you. Perhaps that was why I had to be here on my own.

choices.text: Things weren't perfect, but you have nothing to feel ashamed of.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Indeed.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So, those strange houses today, huh... And a... a mirage-bonsai? Basically, lots of weird stuff today! Do you think we should tell Venti about it?

choices.text: I thought you were gonna ask me that.

response.speaker: Dodocommunication Device
response.text: Dodoco! Dodoco!

response.speaker: Dodocommunication Device
response.text: Dodoco! Dodoco! Dodoco!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: There's no answer... That's weird, why is he ignoring us?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: This doesn't seem like him...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Maybe he got distracted? Or he forgot to bring the bomb to his performance? Or maybe he got drunk and fell asleep under that huge tree...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm... maybe we should try contacting him tomorrow.

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: Traveler, Paimon. So here you are.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Mona! Are you all done chatting with Fischl?

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: Hahaha, close enough... She was a little downcast. I think it has something to do with the mirage we saw today.

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: Fischl has been very excited about this trip from the start... but I have a feeling she doesn't want to see her own mirage...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Why? It seems like this'd be the kind of thing she really enjoys.

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: ...I'm not sure at this stage, but I'll keep an eye on her.

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: There's something else I wanted to tell you. I tried performing a divination again on the beach.

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: My scryglass was still blurry, but I felt a force coming from within. I couldn't see its exact position, but I knew that it was changing.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: How could you tell that if you couldn't see it clearly?

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: Hmm, how can I explain this concept to non-experts... Oh, I know! It's like we're sitting in a room and there's a crack in the walls. We don't know where it is, but everyone can feel the wind rushing in.

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: Not only that, but the room is getting colder.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ohh! Paimon gets it now! So you wanna find where that crack is, right?

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: You could say that. I need to see the crack first before deciding what to do next.

dialogues.speaker: Old Servant
dialogues.text: Master, we're the only servants left! Are you sure about this? After we're gone, who's going to...

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Don't worry, I'll be fine.

dialogues.speaker: Old Servant
dialogues.text: Your mother died early, and now that your father has left you... You're all that remains of this clan now...

dialogues.speaker: Old Servant
dialogues.text: I suppose that this is the last time we will ever see each other. Master, please take care of yourself.

dialogues.speaker: Sailor
dialogues.text: Everyone, on board!

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Farewell.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: The Kaedehara Clan has ultimately disbanded in my hands.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: But as my father said, I should not let life imprison me. Perhaps living the wanderer's life is what was meant for me after all.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: You know, they say that Visions represent the Archons' gaze.

dialogues.speaker: Friend
dialogues.text: But is being under an Archon's gaze really a blessing?

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: I don't know, maybe...?

dialogues.speaker: Shogunate Infantry
dialogues.text: Vision Hunt Decree! Hand over your Visions now!

dialogues.speaker: Friend
dialogues.text: This way! Hurry!

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: I know very well why people resist against the Vision Hunt Decree.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Ambition is our power in its rawest form. We cannot live without it.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: When no other option remains, I will leave.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: My grandfather once traveled to Liyue, while my father read about Mondstadt... but where is the right place for me?

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: ...The sky's getting dark. It looks like it's going to rain.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Will the rain ever stop?
